valores.label: Temporary prison camps set up by San Quentin

fonte: Federal Highway Administration, "California's Pacific Coast Highway-Highway One" (Back in Time, Rickie Longfellow)
dataDoDado: 1919–1937 (a FHWA não dá o ano dos acampamentos)
legenda: Wages in the dollars of the time.
texto_para_tela: SAN QUENTIN · 3 TEMPORARY CAMPS · 35¢ A DAY · SENTENCES REDUCED · FHWA
nota: FHWA, relida: 'San Quentin Prison set up three temporary prison camps…'; 'Inmates were paid 35 cents per day and their prison sentences reduced'. Os três: Little Sur River, Kirk Creek e, depois, Anderson Creek. 35¢ nominais, sem correção pela inflação (roupa §3).
licenca: domínio público (obra do governo federal dos EUA); o texto vai recriado, com atribuição

pedidos.pedido: L4 (FHWA): 'San Quentin Prison set up three temporary prison camps to provide the labor for the road' (R116, R118); 'Inmates were paid 35 cents per day and their prison sentences reduced' (R119). Tela SAN QUENTIN · 3 TEMPORARY CAMPS · 35¢ A DAY · SENTENCES REDUCED · FHWA.
